groups.activity: complete The New War, then Veilbreaker
conditions: Break Narmer is solo-only: you play as Kahl-175, so squads and carries cannot shorten this farm.
Check the inventory first. Styanax was awarded during two limited promotions and may already be built on older accounts.

rows.label: Stock
rows.alt: challenge rewards plus repeatable Stock crates

conditions: A completed mission advances the active rotation and grants exactly one Garrison rank. Skipping a week delays Rank 5 by a full week.
The missions rotate Sneaky Sabotage, Junk Run, and Prison Break, resetting Monday at 00:00 UTC.
Six challenges pay up to 105 Stock each week: Deathless pays 30 and the other five pay 15. Up to five collectible crates grant 2 Stock each per completed run.
Crate Stock requires extraction. Challenge Stock is paid immediately when completed and remains if a later run is aborted.
bonuses: Bank the weekly completion first, then split challenges across runs: a careful collectible run and a separate under-15-minute/Deathless run are substantially less frustrating.
Kahl has innate Loot and Enemy Radar; collectibles and objectives appear on the minimap.
If a week is busy, finish the mission just for the rank and make up Stock later with crate replays.

disclosures.title: calendar gate, not an RNG farm
disclosures.body: Rank 5 cannot be reached before four weekly completions. Stock is normally comfortable at 105 challenge Stock per week; the unavoidable minimum is four weeks plus the final 72-hour Foundry build.

groups.activity: buy each blueprint when its rank unlocks
conditions: Chipper appears at Rank 2. Purchase each component immediately on reaching its required rank rather than hoarding until Rank 5.
Styanax is not in the Circuit. The Market's 175-platinum listing is the completed Warframe, not a credit blueprint.
bonuses: Starting each 12-hour component build in weeks 1-3 leaves only the 72-hour final build after the fourth weekly mission.

groups.activity: gather build materials before each component purchase
conditions: Do not buy the Neuroptics blueprint until the two Argon Crystals are ready; unused Argon halves daily.
The alloy and gem requirements need their respective reusable refining blueprints from the open-world vendors.
bonuses: Kahl weeks provide enough calendar time to gather these materials before each component's rank unlocks.
